searchScope: Repository landing pages, project documentation, release notes, and the Minecraft Dungeons-specific UE4SS issue listed below were inspected on 2026-09-23. This is a bounded census, not proof that no other private or unindexed work exists.

projects.versionOrDate: Database identifies game files version 1.17.0.0; page accessed 2026-09-23
projects.whatItExtracts: Public site presents item Power, Speed, and Area ratings and says its database is read from Minecraft Dungeons 1.17.0.0 game files.
projects.nativeRelevance: The damage comparison page says absolute damage needs a gear-power curve compiled into the executable and absent from paks. It uses relative item ratings and a shared-curve ratio instead of an absolute damage result.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: Prioritize a clean boundary between pak-derived item ratings and executable-side power scaling. The public page does not expose an implementation or address, and no code-level source link was found in the bounded inspection.
projects.independentLocalVerification: The local executable and Stage 1 payload were inspected, but no power curve or damage implementation was identified. The claim remains external-only.
projects.license: Not stated on the inspected page; no code used.

projects.whatItExtracts: Edits Minecraft Dungeons save files and reads installed pak files for game images. Its README lists DungeonTools and PakReader submodules.
projects.nativeRelevance: Useful save and pak workflow prior art; no executable function, class address, SDK, or native mechanic implementation was identified in the inspected repository material.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: Separate save/pak acquisition from executable analysis. No code was reused.
projects.independentLocalVerification: Not applicable to native code; no native claim to verify.
projects.license: Repository MIT. README separately attributes DungeonTools AGPL-3.0, FModel GPL-3.0, and PakReader MIT; no code copied.

projects.whatItExtracts: Libraries and tools for Minecraft Dungeons save files and game data workflows.
projects.nativeRelevance: Save-file and packaged-data tooling, not executable implementation evidence.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: Use as a lead for save and pak boundaries only. No code was reused.

projects.versionOrDate: main branch and listed releases as viewed 2026-09-23; README describes a research-purpose save editor
projects.whatItExtracts: Edits save data and reads installed game data for displayed images and text. The inspected README does not describe native executable analysis.
projects.nativeRelevance: No native class/function dump or executable mechanics evidence found.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: The README confirms a game-install dependency for selected UI assets, not a binary-analysis technique. No code was reused.
projects.license: No license statement was found in the inspected repository landing page; no code used.

projects.whatItExtracts: Provides a Minecraft Dungeons mod authoring and packaging workflow using Unreal Engine 4.22 and cooked assets/resource packs.
projects.nativeRelevance: Useful for asset-side UE4 version and packaging context; it does not publish native game function addresses or mechanics implementation in the inspected material.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: The project explicitly targets UE4 4.22.x. The local PE version resource independently reports 4.22.3.0; this confirms the engine family only, not native class layouts.
projects.independentLocalVerification: UE4 4.22.3.0 independently observed in the local executable resource. No mod-kit code was reused.

projects.versionOrDate: experimental-latest release, short commit f12f0be, viewed 2026-09-23
projects.whatItExtracts: At runtime, UE4SS can dump loaded UObject reflection data, classes, structs, enums, functions, properties, CDO values, and approximate vtable layouts; it also generates SDK headers.
projects.nativeRelevance: Directly relevant as generic UE reflection and live-dump technique prior art. It does not establish that the current Minecraft Dungeons build is supported or that a dump exists.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: A future live reflection dump could join UClass.SuperStruct and UFunction native pointers to the serialized /Script/Dungeons class. No UE4SS code or address was reused.
projects.independentLocalVerification: Not independently verified in Minecraft Dungeons. Current local work did not launch the game or produce a reflection dump.
projects.license: Repository MIT as listed by GitHub; some separately maintained UEPseudo material has distinct terms. No code copied.

projects.project: RE-UE4SS issue #1211: Minecraft Dungeons crash at launch
projects.versionOrDate: Opened 2026-03-12; issue reports Minecraft Dungeons UE4.22.3
projects.whatItExtracts: No dump. The reporter describes a fatal error shortly after launch while locating KismetSystemLibrary:Conv_NameToString.
projects.nativeRelevance: A version-specific compatibility failure report, not successful executable analysis or a confirmed function address.
projects.reusableTechniqueOrInformation: Record the named reflection lookup as a future test target only. Do not treat the report as proof of a local function or address.
projects.independentLocalVerification: Not reproduced; current work did not launch the game or UE4SS.
projects.license: Issue text under the hosting project's terms; no code used.

negativeSearch.finding: No independently verifiable Minecraft Dungeons SDK/reflection dump, native class/function address list, or executable-side gameplay formula source was located in the bounded public-source pass above.
negativeSearch.scopeLimit: This is a search result, not proof of nonexistence. Leaked-source claims were excluded.
negativeSearch.localFollowUp: No local FNamePool, GUObjectArray, UObject, UClass, UFunction, /Script/Dungeons, GameplayEffect, or common RTTI marker was found by the bounded ASCII/UTF-16 scan of the raw executable and Stage 1 output. Encoded or runtime-generated names remain possible.
